state:
Goal `core-metrics-and-4-more`, stage 2, per-member feature proofs. `Core\Metrics` is done: all three
members carry every proof, and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Metrics'` passes. `Core\Mime` is
done too: `detect` and `mediaType` carry every proof, the class has its card, and each member's Rust
test has its `covers:` marker. Its group check passes. `Core\Net`, `Core\Net\Datagram` and
`Core\Net\Datagram\Message` still owe every proof, and none of the three classes has a card. Every
`Core\Metrics` write allocates 8 times a call; that is gap
`nvs-stdlib/a-metrics-write-allocates-on-every-call` (owner M12), and each metrics bench carries its
`// proof: gap` marker. Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **`Core\Net`'s class card** — `rule:core-api/reference-card`. Add a `ClassDoc` above `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:199` and delete `Core\Net` from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:5189`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/mime.rs`'s `CARD` is the shape.

**`Core\Net::connect` and `Core\Net::listen`** — owe about, examples, hostile, perf and a Rust `covers:` marker (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:199`. Read the existing `#[cfg(test)]` module in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs` first: a test there that already drives the member only needs its marker. An example needs a peer in the same program, so check what the conformance cases that call `Core\Net::listen(` do before writing one.

backlog: `Core\Net\Datagram` and `Core\Net\Datagram\Message` owe every proof and a class card each, after `Core\Net` — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:692` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/net.rs:870`.

Reading a `bytes` element from an `array<bytes>` allocates 2 times a read (measured with `nvs run --count`, not checked in the source). If that is a copy and not a reference, it is a latency cost on the request path; owner not decided.
